vpn.configKept: A config is already in place; connecting another replaces it.
vpn.configReady: A valid WireGuard config, ready to use.
vpn.invalidConfig: This is not a complete WireGuard config: [Interface], [Peer], a key or the Endpoint is missing.
vpn.modalHelp: Paste the WireGuard config from your provider (AirVPN, IVPN, a self-hosted peer...). Prefer a server that allows P2P. Only torrent traffic goes through the tunnel; the rest of the server is not affected.
vpn.modeMullvad: Mullvad · {place} ({server}). Torrent traffic goes through the tunnel.
vpn.modeOff: No VPN: torrent traffic goes out directly.
vpn.modeProton: Proton VPN · {server}. Torrent traffic goes through the tunnel.
vpn.modeWireguard: WireGuard config managed by KROMA. Torrent traffic goes through the tunnel (local port :{port}).
vpn.mullvadAccountHint: The 16 digits of your mullvad.net account. Asked for once.
vpn.mullvadDevice: This server is the device {name} on your account.
vpn.mullvadIntro: KROMA makes its own WireGuard key and sends Mullvad only the public half. Your account number stays on this server and is never shown again.
vpn.mullvadInvalidAccount: Mullvad does not know this account number.
vpn.mullvadMaxDevices: This account has no device slot left. Remove one to make room for this server.
vpn.mullvadNoRelay: No active Mullvad server there right now.
vpn.mullvadOwnedOnlyHint: Machines Mullvad owns rather than rents. Fewer countries, fewer middlemen.
vpn.mullvadPlacesFailed: Mullvad's server list cannot be reached right now.
vpn.mullvadThrottled: Mullvad asks to wait a little before trying again.
vpn.mullvadUnavailable: Mullvad is not answering. Try again in a moment.
vpn.notSealed: The tunnel is not diverting traffic (same IP or proxy unreachable)
vpn.protonIntro: Proton does not let another app make the config: three steps on their site, then drop the file here.
vpn.protonStep1: Open the Downloads page of your Proton VPN account.
vpn.protonStep2: Under WireGuard configuration, pick the Router platform, turn on NAT-PMP (port forwarding) and make one config per country you want, on a P2P server marked with a double arrow.
vpn.protonStep3: Download the .conf files and drop them all below. You will switch between them in one click.
vpn.title: VPN (WireGuard)
